tweet.text:
There is no slow down process outlined in the proposal either which is odd

Training and scaling continue as is along with model releases

Anthropic says the Chinese labs keep up by distilling which means they don’t need high end chips for training runs

That they can keep up is true empirically and they are using local chips too

So the proposal is asking for what exactly except for these oversight teams

But there is no way to do oversight of swarms without massive compute, at ether going to give these teams 10 or 20% of their compute?

Even then if they saw something, could they change the behaviour or stop it?

OpenAI had oversight. It was its board who had lots of power. 

The story of how that went had a new movie made about it
